name: InviteRole
short: Assign roles automatically to users who join via specific invite links
description: Create unique Discord invite links or link existing ones to automatically assign designated roles upon member join. Includes real-time invite caching, single-use tracking, logging, and DM notifications.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server invite codes and assigned role IDs. It does not store personal user data.
install_msg: InviteRole loaded. Use `[p]inviterole create <role>` to create your first invite-bound role.
author: Sablinova
